integrity: The universal inequality is proved analytically up to an exact symbolic elimination. Decimal values are corroborative only; the displayed polynomial and exact boundary argument carry the proof.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the support {0,1,2,4}; no general four-point-support classification is claimed. Residual originality risk remains for older sparse Lambda(4) or Nikolskii tables indexed under different terminology.
title: Exact \(L^2\)-to-\(L^4\) norm on the nested-progression support \(\{0,1,2,4\}\)
